# TDrive v3.0.1

TDrive v3.0.1 is a feature and fix release for the TDrive fork maintained by Nguyễn Dương Gia Thuận (ndgthuan/tdrive). Its main change is a redesign pass over the Android and iPhone apps, plus automatic photo and video backup and a link downloader on the phone. It also adds shared-drive roles with a Members dialog, which were not part of v3.0.0.

## Highlights

- Mobile (Android and iPhone) redesign pass across the main screens.
- Auto backup: back up every photo and video on the phone to a My Drive folder named after the device.
- Download from link (yt-dlp) on Android and iPhone.
- Shared-drive roles (Owner, Manager, Editor, Viewer) with a Members dialog and role-aware controls.
- Linux AppImage fix for extracting FFmpeg, and the Go toolchain moves to 1.26.10 for a security update.

## Mobile redesign

- **Files**: new header, a drive switcher with member counts and Owner or Viewer badges, and view-only shared drives marked as such.
- **Selection and actions**: a photo selection bar, a file action sheet, and confirmation before moving items to Trash.
- **Rename and move**: dedicated sheets for renaming and moving files and folders.
- **Trash**: Restore buttons on trashed items.
- **Search**: a results view for search.
- **Video**: a video menu for playback actions.
- **Account and About**: a redesigned Account tab, and an About panel with **Copy diagnostics** for bug reports.
- **Join and Create shared drive**: sheets for joining an existing shared drive or creating a new one.
- **Login**: the sign-in form now has a Next step.
- **Shared-drive list**: the list no longer disappears when a load fails. The sheet shows a retry action, and the app retries with backoff.

## Auto backup

- Turn on **Auto backup** in the phone's settings. TDrive creates a My Drive folder named after the phone (for example iPhone, Pixel, Samsung, Xiaomi or OnePlus) and backs up all photos and videos into it.
- New photos and videos are uploaded as they appear.
- Backup waits for the conditions you choose: Wi-Fi only (on by default), charging only, and a battery that is not low. Progress is shown in Transfers, and **Back up now** starts a run immediately.
- iPhone reads the library through PhotoKit and uploads original files, including those stored in iCloud. Android reads the MediaStore.

## Download from link on the phone

- **Android** uses youtubedl-android to run yt-dlp.
- **iPhone** runs yt-dlp with an embedded Python. Merging separate video and audio streams and audio-only presets need FFmpeg, which the iPhone build does not include yet, so those presets are not offered on iPhone.

## Shared-drive roles

- Each shared drive has one of four roles: **Owner**, **Manager**, **Editor** or **Viewer**. Roles are enforced by Telegram, and the app shows only the actions the role allows.
- The **Members** dialog lists who has access and their roles.
- Viewer access is read-only in the app: viewers see the drive but the controls that change it are hidden or refused.

## Fixes

- **Linux**: fixes FFmpeg extraction on Linux.
- **Security**: Go is updated to 1.26.10 to fix GO-2026-6809.

## Platform notes

- **Android (arm64)**: APK signed with this fork's release key. Android will not install it over an APK signed with the upstream key, so uninstall the upstream app first.
- **Android minimum is now Android 7.0 (API 24).** v3.0.0 still accepted Android 5.0. Devices older than Android 7.0 cannot install this release.
- **iOS**: the IPA (`TDrive-v3.0.1-ios-unsigned.ipa`) is signed only ad hoc, with no Apple developer certificate or provisioning profile, so it cannot be installed through the App Store or TestFlight. TrollStore installs it as-is; Sideloadly and AltStore re-sign it with your own Apple ID.
- **macOS (Apple silicon, arm64)**: the app bundle is not notarized. macOS may ask you to confirm opening it the first time (right-click, Open).
- **Windows (amd64)**: installer and portable zip, plus the CLI archive.
- **Linux (amd64)**: AppImage, self-contained (glibc 2.35 or newer).

## Known limits

- **Android minimum is now 7.0 (API 24).** Phones on Android 5.0 or 6.0 are no longer supported.
- The mobile code is new and has not yet been tested on many real devices. Expect rough edges, and use **Copy diagnostics** in About when reporting one.
- Shared-drive roles have not yet been verified against live Telegram accounts with several members. Treat role checks as a first pass until that testing is done.
- iPhone yt-dlp downloads are not yet proven on a device.
- No background auto backup while the app is closed.
- Phone yt-dlp downloads pause when the app goes to the background.
- Automatic installation of yt-dlp and FFmpeg is available on Windows only. On macOS and Linux, install both yourself and make sure they are on your PATH.

## Upgrade notes

- Desktop data and configuration directories are unchanged, so existing data is found automatically.
- Do not downgrade to v2.x after using v3.0.0 or v3.0.1 on the same account. Older builds parse only the `TDX1` caption form, so they cannot read the readable captions these versions write.
- Android: see Platform notes; the APK cannot update over an upstream-signed install.

- Android signer certificate SHA-256: `A8:F4:4A:72:E0:56:E1:79:DE:19:4C:F3:E3:10:84:9D:5C:B6:BA:5A:58:EC:5F:A6:AD:BA:DD:29:FB:DC:22:92`
